name: HC28c: Suppressed viral load
description:
Number of pregnant or breastfeeding women who are active on ART, whose most recent viral load test as of the end of the reporting period was performed within the preceding 3 months, and whose same most recent valid viral load result was suppressed.
The patient must be active on ART, must have started ART, and the latest ART-card assessment on or before :endDate must indicate PREGNANT or Breast feeding. The patient's most recent actual VL episode on or before :endDate must fall within the preceding 3 months, where the VL date is determined from sample_collection_date, then viral_load_clinical_date, laboratory_result_date, and lastly order_date; the episode must contain evidence that testing or a result actually occurred, and that same most recent episode must have is_valid_result = 1 and is_suppressed = 1. An older suppressed VL must not qualify the patient when a newer VL episode exists.
